hypothesis: Fixed hourly SMA20 timing may improve net return or downside tradeoff versus equal-quantity buy-and-hold after costs; this is a screening experiment, not proof of future alpha.
rule: completed_close > inclusive_last_20_completed_closes_mean => hold 0.001 BTC; otherwise hold cash; trade only on target changes
execution: next hour open with adverse slippage; no historical spread or depth available; no same-bar close fills; no leverage or shorts

evaluation.baseline_entry: same evaluation-start open, 0.001 BTC plus remaining cash; identical costs and terminal liquidation assumptions
evaluation.equity: initial 1000 plus each completed hourly close marked to hypothetical liquidation, with adverse exit slippage and exit fee; no forced terminal order
evaluation.drawdown: largest peak-to-trough decline of this hourly-close liquidation equity including initial 1000; not intrahour drawdown
evaluation.return_to_drawdown: period net profit divided by maximum drawdown in USDT; undefined if drawdown is zero; descriptive, not annualized
evaluation.exposure: fraction of evaluation hours holding 0.001 BTC; lower drawdown alone is not proof of timing skill
evaluation.quarters_months: changes in continuous year-account liquidation equity at calendar boundaries; no independent account resets within year
evaluation.trade_summary: completed round trips separately from any terminal open position; include actual fees and distinguish hypothetical exit fee

decision_policy.abandon_fixed_version: holdout base net profit <= 0 AND stress net profit <= 0
decision_policy.continue_to_forward_test_only: holdout base and stress net profit > 0, at least 3 of 4 base quarters profitable, AND either (base net profit >= buy-hold net profit AND base max drawdown <= buy-hold max drawdown) OR (base max drawdown <= 75% of buy-hold max drawdown AND base profit/drawdown > buy-hold profit/drawdown)
decision_policy.interpretation: 25% drawdown improvement and 3-quarter breadth are predeclared research-budget screening choices, not statistical confidence thresholds; abandoning this fixed version does not reject all trend strategies

data_policy: official monthly spot archives plus published SHA256 checksums; complete UTC calendar years and preceding 20 hours; reject gaps, duplicates, invalid OHLCV and unexpected timestamp units; preserve ZIPs and source manifest
holdout_policy: 2024 may debug implementation but may not tune strategy; freeze tested code hash before viewing 2025 performance; any later correction preserves original outputs and is disclosed; 2025 historical holdout is not fresh future data
runtime_boundary: separate artifact directory; preserve existing GUI binary, paper journal, account and paused heartbeat; no real orders or new recurring validation
